members.name: bollinger_squeeze_breakout_v82
members.thesis: Volatility is cyclical; periods of low volatility (squeeze) are followed by explosive expansion. Breakouts from the squeeze predict the direction of the expansion. Exists because prolonged consolidation builds unexecuted order book resting liquidity.
entry_long: bb_upper < keltner_upper AND bb_lower > keltner_lower AND close > bb_upper
entry_short: bb_upper < keltner_upper AND bb_lower > keltner_lower AND close < bb_lower
weaknesses: Fakeouts are common right before the True reversal
Needs strong relative volume to confirm, otherwise it flatlines
Difficult to define a tight stop loss due to volatility expansion

members.name: bollinger_squeeze_breakout
members.thesis: Exploits the transition from low volatility to high volatility. Markets are fractal; periods of extreme range contraction (Bollinger Bands inside Keltner Channels) lead to explosive breakouts. Behavioral bias: traders ignore quiet stocks, allowing the 'smart money' to build positions silently.
weaknesses: Squeeze can last longer than the intraday session
